jlcpcb.title: JLCPCB both-sides PCBA
jlcpcb.disclaimer: No partnership with JLCPCB. Orders at your own risk. Fab UI labels change — follow outcomes, not exact button names.
steps: Go to jlcpcb.com and sign in or create an account.
Click Order Now and upload the Gerber file.
Enable PCB Assembly at the bottom of the page.
Set PCBA Type: Standard, Assembly Side: Both sides, then continue.
Continue again and upload the BOM file and CPL file.
Review stock and orientation, then finalise checkout.

items.label: M2 screws + nuts
items.notes: Pan/button-head for plastic: 8× M2×4, 27× M2×8 (BottomCover heads ≤ 4.0 mm × 2.0 mm), 15× M2×16, 6× M2 nuts. Linked 1080-pc kit covers M2×4–×25 + nuts.

items.notes: Need both: ≥2 A supply (1 A phone charger browns out) and a data USB-C cable (charge-only fails flash/serial).
items.blurb: ≥2 A supply and a data USB-C cable.

items.notes: One pack (≥10 wires). Extend OLED and servo leads when stock cables are short. Adafruit 1953 is 6″ (15 cm) M–F — fine.
